quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fire alarm activated in the hospital emergency ward. Input evacuation code!
quests.hint: Issue the ward evacuation order.
quests.explanation: Evacuating medical wards immediately protects patients and staff before smoke can spread through ventilation.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Smoke detected in hospital records storage on floor 3. Input response code!
quests.hint: Send the fire crew to floor three.
quests.explanation: Rapid fire crew deployment to the correct floor isolates the source before smoke spreads to clinical areas.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Emergency sprinkler triggered in hospital corridor B2. Input confirmation code!
quests.hint: Confirm sprinkler activation in zone B.
quests.explanation: Verifying which zone activated helps emergency teams distinguish between real fires and accidental triggers.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Student collapsed and unresponsive during sports class. Input response code!
quests.hint: Dispatch CPR response team one.
quests.explanation: Immediate CPR within four minutes dramatically increases survival rates from sudden cardiac arrest.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Kitchen worker has a deep cut from an industrial blade. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the red trauma kit immediately.
quests.explanation: Red trauma kits contain pressure dressings designed to control severe bleeding from industrial lacerations.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Child showing severe allergic reaction symptoms in the cafeteria. Input treatment code!
quests.hint: Trigger the epinephrine auto-injector.
quests.explanation: Epinephrine reverses anaphylactic shock by opening blocked airways and stabilizing blood pressure quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: River flooding approaching residential streets near the east bank. Input barrier code!
quests.hint: Deploy the flood barrier now.
quests.explanation: Deployable flood barriers redirect rising water away from homes and reduce property damage during river overflow.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Underground parking garages flooding rapidly in the city center. Input pump code!
quests.hint: Activate the nearest pump station.
quests.explanation: High-capacity pump stations remove thousands of liters per minute to prevent vehicles from being submerged.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Elderly resident trapped inside flooded ground-floor apartment. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Dispatch the boat rescue team.
quests.explanation: Shallow-water rescue boats access flooded streets where standard emergency vehicles cannot operate.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Worker exposed to unknown chemical on the loading dock. Input decontamination code!
quests.hint: Activate the decontamination shower.
quests.explanation: Immediate decontamination showers remove surface chemicals before they are absorbed through the skin.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Corrosive liquid spilled near the building ventilation intake. Input air control code!
quests.hint: Shut down the HVAC system immediately.
quests.explanation: Stopping ventilation prevents corrosive vapors from circulating through the entire building air supply.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Three workers showing signs of chemical irritation and dizziness. Input code!
quests.hint: Notify the poison control center now.
quests.explanation: Poison control provides the exact treatment protocol based on the specific chemical involved.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Multi-vehicle collision blocking the highway interchange. Input traffic code!
quests.hint: Close the highway at delta point.
quests.explanation: Closing entry roads before the crash scene prevents more vehicles from entering the danger zone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Fuel spilling from an overturned tanker at the junction. Input standby code!
quests.hint: Put the fire unit on immediate standby.
quests.explanation: Fuel-spill incidents require a fire unit on standby to suppress any ignition before flames spread.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Pedestrian struck by vehicle and unconscious in the road. Input trauma code!
quests.hint: Dispatch trauma unit one immediately.
quests.explanation: Trauma units carry advanced life support equipment including spinal boards needed for road accident victims.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Four passengers trapped in elevator between floors 8 and 9. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Deploy the elevator technician.
quests.explanation: Certified elevator technicians can safely lower a stuck cab to the nearest floor without risk of freefall.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Elevator motor overheating detected in the building control room. Input shutdown code!
quests.hint: Trip the motor breaker immediately.
quests.explanation: Tripping the motor breaker stops the elevator safely and prevents motor fires from developing in the shaft.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Smoke entering the elevator shaft from a nearby office fire. Input code!
quests.hint: Seal the elevator shaft vent door.
quests.explanation: Sealing shaft vents stops smoke from traveling vertically through the building, protecting anyone inside.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Main power transformer blown in the eastern city district. Input reroute code!
quests.hint: Reroute the power grid through sector 3.
quests.explanation: Rerouting power via sector 3 keeps supply running to hospitals and emergency services during transformer failure.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Street lighting has failed across three residential blocks. Input repair code!
quests.hint: Send the night shift fault crew.
quests.explanation: Night shift fault crews carry mobile lighting and diagnostic tools to restore power safely in the dark.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Hospital backup generator failing during a mains power outage. Input priority code!
quests.hint: Activate the emergency supply unit.
quests.explanation: Emergency supply units provide portable power directly to critical hospital equipment like ventilators and ICUs.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Trees down blocking three main roads after a severe windstorm. Input code!
quests.hint: Deploy the road clearing crew now.
quests.explanation: Rapid road clearance after storms restores access routes for emergency vehicles responding to further incidents.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: High winds tearing roofing panels from the community center building. Input code!
quests.hint: Order an immediate building safety check.
quests.explanation: Safety checks identify weakened roof sections before they collapse and injure people inside the building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Lightning strike ignited a shed adjacent to a fuel storage area. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Dispatch the pump engine to sector 7.
quests.explanation: Pump engines carry foam suppressants specifically effective on fuel-adjacent outdoor structure fires.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Seven-year-old child reported missing inside a shopping mall. Input alert code!
quests.hint: Issue an amber mall lockdown now.
quests.explanation: Mall lockdowns close exit points, enabling a systematic search before a missing child can leave the building.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Child last seen near the north parking area on level three. Input search code!
quests.hint: Review CCTV footage for north level 3.
quests.explanation: Reviewing CCTV footage quickly narrows the search area and identifies who the child was last seen with.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Missing child located near the emergency exit by a security officer. Input escort code!
quests.hint: Escort the child to the designated safe room.
quests.explanation: Trained security staff escort found children directly to a safe room away from the public area.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Tornado warning issued for the southern county region. Input shelter code!
quests.hint: Issue the county-wide shelter alert.
quests.explanation: Shelter alerts direct residents to move immediately to storm-safe rooms or reinforced public shelters.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Flash flood warning for the low-lying coastal town. Input evacuation code!
quests.hint: Order an immediate coastal zone evacuation.
quests.explanation: Low-lying coastal areas can flood within minutes; early evacuation prevents residents from being trapped by water.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Severe hail forecast likely to damage aircraft at the regional airport. Input code!
quests.hint: Secure all aircraft inside the hangars.
quests.explanation: Hangar protection prevents hail from shattering cockpit glass and denting fuselages during severe storms.
